whatLead: Each problem follows a different path.
whatSlowBody: The free diagnosis measures how it feels on mobile and explains it clearly.
whatFullBody: Old revisions, expired transients, and spam. You see the list before anything is removed. The one-time fee is $29 and can be undone for 7 days.
whatDownBody: We check the home page every 15 minutes. A 404 sends an email. Two failures in a row, like a 503, prepare the phone alert. We do not bring the site back up from here.
whatHackTitle: Is your site already down or suspended?
whatHackBody: If WordPress shows a white screen, was hacked, or your host suspended it for malware, the connector cannot get in. In those cases we refer you to specialists in manual disinfection.
whatHackNote: CuidadoWeb does not do that cleanup and does not promise the site will be clean. This email only requests the referral. The guarantee is the specialist’s. If your question is about that cleanup, support will send you back to them.
